messages:
Alice K: Quick Q — we ran into a capacity cliff in us-west2 yesterday for A100p instances. Thinking about switching primary strategy from price-optimized to capacity-optimized for critical pools. Thoughts?

Ramon V: +1 for capacity-optimized for latency-sensitive fleets. Price-optimized saved money but we had a 40% reclaim rate during the 18:00-20:00 window.

Tara S: Did we quantify cost delta? capacity-optimized can be 15-30% more depending on region.

Alice K: Yes — rough numbers from the test: price-optimized avg $2.6/hr, capacity-optimized $3.15/hr for same family, but pod eviction down from 38%->6%.

Ben P: How long were the interruptions? warmbuffer sizing?

Mira L: Interrupts averaged 12 mins before eviction, enough to offload small requests, but not long-running evals. Warm buffer of 20 nodes kept 99th p50 okay.

Ramon V: Two other things: cross-region fallback increase egress cost, and multi-arch (A100 vs V100) mismatches cause scheduler thrash.

Alice K: Proposal: keep price-optimized for non-critical batches, capacity-optimized for "interactive" and "short-llm" tiers. For long jobs use preemptible-mix with checkpointing.

Tara S: Agree. Also add bid floor script to avoid <30% of on-demand to reduce churn.

Ben P: Code snippet we used for ASG allocation:

```
aws autoscaling set-instance-health --instance-id $ID --health-status Unhealthy
# instead of terminating we spin warm buffer + spot request with capacity-optimized allocationStrategy
```

Mira L: Can we try a hybrid allocation strategy: capacity-optimized for primary pool, price-optimized for spillover. On preempt we immediately re-route to spillover and spin a short-lived dedicated on-demand replacement if SLO breaches.

infra-bot: auto-reminder — run spot-mix-sim job with seed=20260319, window=7d

Alice K: Action items: Ramon to run sim across 3 regions (us-west2, us-east1, europe-west1), Tara to model cost delta and egress penalty, Ben to add bid-floor and warmbuffer autoscaler. Mira to add checkpoint hook in job launcher. We'll reconvene Friday.

Ramon V: I'll post results as a tiny table once sim finishes.

Tara S: FYI might need legal sign-off for cross-region replication for some customer datasets.

Ben P: :thumbsup: leaning towards hybrid. Small follow-up — what metrics do we track? eviction rate, fallback latency, additional egress cost, effective $/inference.

Alice K: Exactly. Add 95th recovery time and percentage of requests served without model-variant downgrade.

Mira L: I'll wire alerts for >10% eviction in 1h window.

Alice K: Thanks all.
